mentions.name: Stock Market Daytrading System
mentions.description: A stock market daytrading system, live coded on YouTube, built around a nested auction market theory inspired model. It replaces time with volume on the chart x-axis and puts bar duration in a bottom panel instead of volume, which normalizes price movements and makes profitable setups from tape reading and price ladder trading courses visible on naked charts. It is based on the insight that variance should be proportional to volume rather than time or trade count, expanding high-volume areas and compressing low-volatility ones to expose trending price action.
mentions.problem: Profitable setups described in tape reading and price ladder trading courses are not visible on standard time-based (naked) charts.
